personalInfo.summary: Python Backend & GenAI Developer with 2+ years of professional experience building enterprise AI workflows, self-healing data pipelines, and scalable microservices. Specialized in ClickHouse OLAP architectures, LangGraph vectorless retrieval, multi-attribute decision engines, and resilient FastAPI backends.

featuredSystems.title: Self-Healing Data Pipeline & AI Reporting Agent
featuredSystems.subtitle: Enterprise Salesforce-to-ClickHouse ETL with Automated Schema-Drift Recovery
featuredSystems.description: Engineered an incremental Salesforce-to-ClickHouse ETL pipeline synchronizing 11 core enterprise objects (~10K records per sync, 500K historical capacity) for sub-second analytical rollups. Engineered an automated schema-drift self-healing engine that introspects Salesforce metadata, generates ClickHouse DDL, populates an isolated shadow staging table, and performs an atomic zero-downtime table swap (EXCHANGE TABLES) with automated rollback. Developed a LangGraph-driven vectorless RAG workflow with customized open-source PageIndex to process complex PDF/Word schemas without external API fees.

architecturalDecisions.title: Why ClickHouse Columnar OLAP?
architecturalDecisions.detail: Delivers sub-second analytical aggregations and multi-dimensional rollups across wide, sparse custom-field schemas, vastly outperforming row-oriented stores.

architecturalDecisions.title: Why Shadow Table Swap (EXCHANGE TABLES)?
architecturalDecisions.detail: In-place schema mutations on active analytical tables can induce locks. Populating an isolated shadow table and executing an atomic EXCHANGE TABLES guarantees zero downtime and zero query disruption during schema drift.

architecturalDecisions.title: Why Vectorless RAG?
architecturalDecisions.detail: Vector similarity search fails on exact schema relationships and hierarchical business rules. Custom PageIndex tree indexes provide 100% deterministic retrieval.

featuredSystems.title: B2B Product Recommendation & Decision Engine
featuredSystems.subtitle: Multi-Stage Constraint Solver & RAG Catalog Ingestion for 442 SKUs
featuredSystems.description: Developed the complete backend workflow for an enterprise B2B product recommendation engine covering 442 configurable industrial product SKUs. Built a hybrid pipeline combining ChromaDB vector retrieval for natural-language buyer intent with a multi-stage deterministic decision engine that applies manufacturing feasibility checks, commercial constraints, and scoring dimensions before candidate ranking.

architecturalDecisions.title: Hybrid Retrieval & Constraint Solver
architecturalDecisions.detail: Combined semantic vector search for buyer intent matching with deterministic constraint validation to guarantee zero hallucinated manufacturing configurations across 442 industrial SKUs.

featuredSystems.title: Scheduled Synchronization & Operational KPI Engine
featuredSystems.subtitle: Multi-Source Incremental ETL & Low-Latency Reporting APIs
featuredSystems.description: Engineered from scratch an incremental synchronization pipeline integrating 9 enterprise data sources (8 Salesforce objects + 1 external DB). Implemented automated cron execution via APScheduler and structured data modeling with SQLAlchemy. Exposed high-throughput REST API endpoints delivering real-time orders, accounts, and operational KPIs to a Next.js executive dashboard.

architecturalDecisions.title: Why Incremental Sync?
architecturalDecisions.detail: Drastically reduced database lock times and network egress by computing state differentials and batch-updating only modified records.

featuredSystems.title: AI Product Visualization System
